title.zh: ⚡️Kalshi计划于12月推出追踪美国CPI与核心通胀指标期货合约
title.en: ⚡️Kalshi计划于12月推出追踪美国CPI与核心通胀指标期货合约

current_state.zh: Kalshi 已确认正在开发追踪美国 CPI 与核心 CPI 的交易所交易期货，目标是在 12 月推出，由 Kalshi Klear 清算并实行周日至周五 24 小时交易；该产品尚未正式推出。
current_state.en: Kalshi has confirmed it is developing exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core CPI, targeting a December launch, cleared by Kalshi Klear with Sunday-Friday 24-hour trading; the product has not yet launched.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️Kalshi计划于12月推出追踪美国CPI与核心通胀指标期货合约
updates.title_en: ⚡️Kalshi计划于12月推出追踪美国CPI与核心通胀指标期货合约
updates.what_changed_zh: Kalshi正向大型银行和对冲基金推介于12月推出追踪美国CPI和核心通胀的交易所交易期货，并聘请前巴克莱交易员Michael Ashton设计合约。
updates.what_changed_en: Kalshi is pitching large banks and hedge funds on a December launch of exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core inflation, with former Barclays trader Michael Ashton hired to design the contracts.

updates.title_zh: 【彭博社：Kalshi 计划 12 月推出与美国 CPI 挂钩的期货合约】
updates.title_en: 【彭博社：Kalshi 计划 12 月推出与美国 CPI 挂钩的期货合约】
updates.what_changed_zh: Kalshi 发言人证实正在开发 CPI 期货；彭博看到的推介文件显示，该期货将由 Kalshi Klear 清算，覆盖未来 12 个参考月份、此后四年提供 5 月和 11 月合约，并实行周日至周五 24 小时交易；报道还称其将成为目前唯一直接与 CPI 挂钩的期货产品。
updates.what_changed_en: A Kalshi spokesperson confirmed the CPI futures are in development; Bloomberg-reviewed pitch documents show Kalshi Klear as clearinghouse, contracts covering 12 reference months plus May/November contracts for the following four years, and Sunday-Friday 24-hour trading; the report also says it would be the only directly CPI-linked futures product currently available.
updates.current_state_zh: Kalshi 已确认正在开发追踪美国 CPI 与核心 CPI 的交易所交易期货，目标是在 12 月推出，由 Kalshi Klear 清算并实行周日至周五 24 小时交易；该产品尚未正式推出。
updates.current_state_en: Kalshi has confirmed it is developing exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core CPI, targeting a December launch, cleared by Kalshi Klear with Sunday-Friday 24-hour trading; the product has not yet launched.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kalshi plans to launch exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core CPI in December, cleared by Kalshi Klear with 24/5 trading and contracts designed by former Barclays trader Michael Ashton, making it the only directly CPI-linked futures product on the market.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kalshi plans to launch exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core CPI in December, cleared by Kalshi Klear with 24/5 trading and contracts designed by former Barclays trader Michael Ashton, making it the only directly CPI-linked futures product on the market.
